models_evaluated: enhanced OpenAI o1 (RAG, ICL, majority voting)

links.outcome: Accuracy on prosthodontic MCQs with vs without retrieval-augmented enhancement (RAG, ICL, majority voting)
links.effect: Enhanced models significantly more accurate on Chinese MCQs (P < .001); higher but non-significant accuracy on English MCQs (P = .145). Knowledge errors fell significantly in Chinese (P < .008), not English (P = .604).
links.quote: Enhanced versions of both DeepSeek-R1 and OpenAI o1 achieved significant accuracy improvement compared with their base versions in Chinese-language multiple-choice questions (C-MCQs) (P < .001).

unlisted_practices: Majority voting (self-consistency) across repeated LLM runs to improve answer accuracy
In-context learning with examples to improve LLM accuracy

screen.practice: retrieval grounding, in-context learning and majority voting added to existing LLMs
screen.reason: Evaluates whether adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), in-context learning, and majority voting to baseline LLMs improves accuracy and reduces errors on dental MCQs.
